question: Does design-balanced local interpolation on unchanged measured features improve cross-design margin and warning behavior over the existing learned blend?
scope: 77 original TRAIN designs, 4454 physical clips, all 37 existing acquisition conditions; original five outer folds and proper-fit/calibration/held design partitions. No reserved splits, simulation, feature changes, retraining or production-default change.
reference: Reuse existing frozen 50/50 107/174-feature MLP blend predictions for seeds42/43/44; these are separate predictors, not an ensemble of seeds.
candidate: Two deterministic neighborhood members in exactly the reference107/174 feature spaces. Scale with the original four acquisition views of proper-fit designs only, using existing fit_ridge_scaling and active-column convention. RMS standardized Euclidean distance; each physical reference clip uses its closest of four acquisition views. Each proper-fit design contributes its closest physical clip. Choose five distinct nearest designs with stable distance ties, take the median of their five clip margins, then average the two member medians 50/50. Fixed k5, no distance weighting, tuning, feature selection or learner search.
tie_break: Reference physical clips in source-row order; designs in lexical order; stable sorting of equal distances. No target-dependent neighbor selection.
calibration: Same existing calibration helper: original four views of calibration designs, residual90% clip interval, finite90% design-max residual interval and residual-RMS Gaussian unsafe probability comparator. Calibration targets do not enter reference library/scaling or point predictions. Existing per-fold warning threshold selection at stable false-warning budgets1%,5%,10%,20%; report actual held false-warning and miss rates, not equalized held rates.
evaluation: Score complete held-fold populations under every condition, not the selected failures. Primary clean plus existing949/951 independent/correlated1%/5% draws. Mean design MAE, strict optimism/underestimation curves, stable/unstable last1/2/5% errors and wrong signs, far-stable m>=.15 errors, calibrated warning tradeoffs, interval coverage/availability and probability scores. Paired fixed-prediction2000 whole-design bootstrap; average reference seeds before design resampling; deterministic candidate is never counted as three independent fits. Retain separate seed comparisons and fold results.
guardrails: No automatic adoption. Require supported useful boundary/warning behavior without hidden far-stable or false-warning deterioration; conservative zero-deterioration screens are descriptive, not formal noninferiority or deployment certification. Named cases are descriptive secondary evidence only.
runtime: Report warm cached-feature row through both neighbor members and calibrated output median/p95 versus both existing MLP members. Waveform normalization/modal/spatial extraction unchanged and excluded. Explicitly not full sensor-to-output latency.
verification: Numerical comparison of blocked BLAS distances against direct squared differences; four-view collapse and distinct-design selection with known margins/ties; target-blind neighbor choice; actual complete-fold smoke, partition isolation, frozen baseline replay, calibration budget checks and complete finite outputs. Atomic fingerprinted fold artifacts support exact resume.
limits: Previously scored acquisitions and repeated exploration; no refit uncertainty, multiplicity correction, irreducible-ambiguity proof or calibrated-confidence claim. The deterministic reference tests this fixed interpolation/metric, not every local learner or GRU. Existing blend and rejected residual/scale integration unchanged; GRU remains live.
